main_text.head: Virtute, Eruditione, Authoritate, excellentissimo Viro,
D. JOHANNI-FRIDERICO Ryhinero, JC. et Reipub. Basileensis Archigrammateo meritissimo;
main_text.p: DOMINO, PATRONO, ET Amico summopere colendo; S. in Christo Redemtore P.

Isceptationem istam, quam Tibi, Vir praestantissime, nunc offero, non-nemo sanè fuerit, qui temerè, aut frustrà, susceптam esse dicitet. Temerè quidem; quòd à me: frustrà autem; quòd adversùs ejusmodi Adversarium. De quo tamen utroque secùs existimandi, argumenta, æquis & candidis rerum æstimatoribus, facilè persuasurum me esse, confido. Ac de me quidem, ut pro necessitate dicam: tametsi meo me-ipsum modulo
main_text.notes: Initial D is a large decorated woodcut letter. Word "susceптam" is printed as "susceptam" with a letter partly unclear: [?] not added since the reading is evident. Text in the lower-left fragment from the neighbouring page is not transcribed.

page.notes: The header ornament is a woodcut band. The first word of the body is a large initial D joined to "Isceptationem" as printed.
